chapter: Guitarists and the Pierron and Brown bands
title: Sorting out Brown's band personnel; dating the memory to 1915
summary: Souchon and Russell try to recall the band's drummers and the Shields-for-Emala swap. Souchon dates the memory to 1915, the year he entered Tulane.
